{{Top|leg}}
A '''ruffle''' was a type of fancy [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]] accessory worn by the [[Noble/Legends|nobles]]. Many rough individuals like [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]], adventurers or [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] considered the wearing of a ruffle as untrue to their nature.<ref name="Luxury">{{WEGCite|story=The Lap of Luxury|book=Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)}}</ref>
